meaning: Quiescent Relay Box / component internal failure wording
context: JLR says this can be a false software log on L405 13MY onward and may not clear.
action: Do not replace GWM or Quiescent Relay Box for this code alone when no matching symptom exists.

context: Listed by JLR among oversensitive 13MY L405 codes that may appear with no evident cause, often around low voltage.
action: Correlate with live symptom and voltage state before chasing the named module.

meaning: Electronic power assisted steering circuit voltage below threshold
context: JLR lists it among low-voltage/oversensitive 13MY codes in the stated no-symptom context.
action: If steering is genuinely heavy, treat as real until battery/charging and steering system are tested.

context: JLR lists it among 13MY diagnostic-noise codes when no cause/symptom is evident.
action: Do not disregard if EPB actually malfunctions; verify calibration and voltage history.

context: JLR lists it among 13MY codes that may be stored without a matching vehicle concern.
action: Check battery/voltage/network context and recurrence before condemning GWM.

context: Listed in JLR SSM62457 as potentially irrelevant in the stated no-cause 13MY diagnostic context.
action: Correlate with programming history and symptoms; do not replace module solely from a historic code.

meaning: High-speed CAN communication bus invalid serial data received
context: JLR says it may be present without a related concern on early L405.
action: If many modules report CAN faults or live symptoms exist, diagnose network/voltage rather than ignoring it.

context: JLR documented incorrect/stacked front number plates obstructing radar below the plate plinth.
action: Inspect plate/radar field first; then proceed to sensor alignment/wiring if clear.

meaning: Gateway-related invalid-data communication code in JLR charging-warning bulletin context
context: SSM68518 ties charging warnings to communication/earth diagnosis and directs an earth check.
action: Prove battery/alternator output and major earth integrity before replacing charging components.

meaning: Dynamic Response fault code listed in JLR bleed SSM
context: Can be associated with air trapped in Dynamic Response hydraulic system after work/opening.
action: Follow JLR bleed/self-test before component replacement when history fits.

meaning: Dynamic Response code listed in JLR SSM64917
context: Can be produced by hydraulic air-lock/bleed state.
action: Bleed and self-test per JLR procedure before condemning valves/modules when history fits.

meaning: Dynamic Response code listed in JLR SSM64917
context: Included in the manufacturer air-lock/bleed diagnostic pattern.
action: Use hydraulic bleed/self-test path before parts if fault followed system opening.

meaning: Dynamic Response code listed in JLR SSM64917
context: Included in manufacturer trapped-air diagnostic pattern.
action: Verify hydraulic bleed state and repeat self-test before replacement.

meaning: Engine oil level sensor circuit range/performance / message-type fault wording reported by L405 community
context: Reported especially on later 4.4 SDV8; may coexist with Oil Level Not Available. Not a universal 2013 code signature.
action: Do not use the forced-read trick as proof the sensor/wiring is healthy; inspect sensor circuit/loom when persistent.

meaning: Engine oil temperature sensor circuit range/performance
context: Community-reported alongside oil-level-sensor faults on later SDV8 wiring issues.
action: Treat as variant-specific; check engine/loom campaign history rather than applying to every L405.
